project.name: Cairn
project.description_md:
Self-hosted workspace: planning, Pivotick graph, Claude Code runs, GitHub, local instances.

This roadmap is imported with `python manage.py roadmap`; the spec is `PROJECT_BRIEF.md`, progress in `docs/PROGRESS.md`.
project.claude_instructions_md:
- Read `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/PROGRESS.md` and `docs/DECISIONS.md` first.
- Route → core; every mutation logged; tests, ruff and bandit before done.
- No AI attribution anywhere.

Changeset review: approve item by item, apply in one transaction
Ask Claude to fill a task: research it in the graph, schedule, resources and GitHub, propose the details
tasks.description_md: At any moment the owner adds a task in a few words (quick add, palette, task page) and asks Claude to fill it. A read-only run gathers context with the app MCP tools: related tasks and the dependency graph (`find_related`, the same code as the task page's Related panel), resources, the schedule (working time, deadlines, calendar once Phase 10 exists), GitHub issues and PRs. It proposes a changeset: description, acceptance criteria, checklist, estimate, priority, dates that fit the schedule, dependencies, resources to attach. The owner approves item by item; nothing is written before.
